report_interpretation: On held-out scene 6, raw RGB matching increases from 13.19 mm MAE under matched lighting to 54.21 mm under changed source lighting (4.11 times). Modeling radiometric nuisance inside matching helps, but the diagonal-channel candidate (36.43 mm) is worse than scalar gain (29.90 mm) and established channel ZNCC (32.84 mm). This supports lighting sensitivity in geometry; it does not establish an extra benefit from color constancy.
aggregation: Arithmetic mean of per-view/light MAE. Matched: light3, 3 reference views. Changed: lights0,1,2,4,5,6, 18 view/light cases. One evaluation scene.
scope_limits: One held-out scene; descriptive results only, no population confidence intervals
320x240 plane sweep, finite depth planes and projected point samples, not full-resolution DTU benchmark
GT source visibility and foreground plane define evaluation mask only; no GT enters inference
DTU lights primarily change direction; gains model radiometric nuisance, no absolute illuminant recovery claim
